children: Australia’s Cotality Home Value Index fell 0.9% month-on-month in August 2026, following a 1.2% decline in July.

Home values are now 3.6% below their peak, although still 2.7% higher than a year earlier, as the housing downturn spread across more capital cities and regional areas, with the prospect of further policy tightening pointing to tougher conditions ahead.
Sydney and Melbourne again led the declines, falling 1.4% and 1.1%, respectively.
Nearly all capital cities recorded losses, with momentum also cooling in previously strong markets such as Brisbane and Perth, which fell 1.0% and 0.8%, respectively.

Cotality said Sydney prices, now 7.1% below their February peak, were now falling faster than during the 2022-23 correction, when the RBA raised interest rates by 425 basis points and home values declined 6.6%.

title: Australian Home Prices Extend Decline
